checks: A newer owner Stop that fails a pending Reboot returns the paused Agenda and Study timers; the hold is preserved and nothing restarts by itself
Save cancellation and a save failure before begin() report "Off not started" with no cycle or admission change recorded, instead of an incomplete cycle
Explicit On reports the phone listener as observed and unchanged by On, instead of asserting that phone access is off
A Running record without a live worker is counted as stale_running and the drain names the route that resolves it; Off completes after the record is terminal
After a completed Off, Settings re-enable plus Resume returns the paused timers through refresh(); no Hatch route is required
With 300 completed records carrying exited worker pids an idle drain() tick stays under 0.1 s; terminal rows are no longer probed
An unreadable cycle row disables only the service actions; Operations keeps its queue and the UNAVAILABLE message is shown once, not every tick
A partial cycle row reads UNAVAILABLE through the timer slot, the service room and ledger.operations without a KeyError
A failure after the committed ON journals the problem and keeps ON readable; the model reload note follows the observed job and model state while the stored note stays a request
Declining the service confirmation leaves admission and the cycle journal untouched

Off from the menu saves the working file with its mode, cancels the queued record and waits for the running one; while draining all three service actions are disabled and New Idea and New Project stay available
The provider in-flight indicators hold the drain after every job is terminal; Off completes once they clear; no provider request is issued

While services are off: Off is unavailable with the reason already off and On is the way back; the service room says services off; a direct desktop command and a new cloud reply are refused while editing stays available
On from the menu reopens admission and releases the hold together; it replays no cancelled record and leaves the unfinished edit in its tab
Reboot from the menu cycles the services in the same window and saves the unfinished edit with its mode kept
Clean close runs LedgerLifecycle.shutdown(): the 1 s timer stops and the close thread is joined; zero native, model or provider launches

captures.note: The actual warning when Save fails before any cycle begins: titled "not started"; no cycle row and no admission change were recorded.
A disposable Running record whose recorded worker pid has exited: the drain hold names Master Stop and Work trail → recover instead of waiting silently. No worker exists.

An unreadable service-cycle row: the System menu's Graphite services On, Off and Restart disabled, New Idea and New Project (Work) available, the Operations queue and Agenda still readable, one status message instead of one per second.
Readback after a committed ON whose later step failed: the phase stays ON with new work enabled; the model note says the reload request did not complete. Nothing is launched.

Off chosen from the menu: the working file was saved, one disposable Queued record was cancelled and one Running record keeps the cycle draining. New work is held while the window stays usable; no worker exists.

Inspect Operations and Work trail, then choose again.
